Hvardiiske Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Khmelnytskyi Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Hvardiiske's Jewish population reached an extraordinary 95 percent of the town by 1897, served across generations by a documented line of rabbis — Israel Kutiver, his son Mordechai Kutiver, and David-Shlomo Novoseller (1877–1966). On February 16, 1919, a pogrom organized by Ukrainian People's Republic authorities killed 686 people, according to one source, or 485 according to another — a discrepancy worth noting rather than resolving. In the 1970s and 80s, all of Hvardiiske's remaining Jews left for Israel. This is the older of Hvardiiske's two Jewish cemeteries.
